prompt: From orbit, a storm system of grey night cloud swirls over Britain, the coastline showing only through its gaps; inside the cloud, dozens of small orange and white flashes light it from beneath, spread from Cornwall to Scotland, so the whole sheet of cloud flickers like a thunderstorm made of fires. A thin blue line of atmosphere on the curved horizon, stars above. Deep shadow, grain, a real photograph taken from the space station. 16:9, no text.
